author: KEXP
description: All Them Witches' trademark blend of heavy psychedelic blues-rock and hypnotic groove take new twists and turns on their latest release 'House of Mirrors.' In-studio with host Troy Nelson, the Nashville band share a performance of "Hold Up, Say What?" and more from the record.
title: All Them Witches performs "Hold Up, Say What?" & more Live on KEXP
